newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 starts lower, awaits PPI for direction.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 starts lower, awaits PPI for direction.

text.p: UK shares edged lower at the start on Monday, marking time ahead of the latest price data in the absense of any major scheduled corporate news today.
"It's going to be pretty quiet today," said one trader. "We're twiddling our thumbs until we see what the PPI numbers can tell us."
The UK's leading index was down 8.9 points at 4,019.2 by 0739 GMT, after finishing just 19-points off its all-time high on Friday.
Ex-dividend stocks accounted for 3.347 points of the fall.
